title: Modular exponentiation initialization
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, initialize a state by encoding the second component of the second component of $z$, the first component of the second component of $z$, the remainder of the first component of $z$ modulo the second component of the second component of $z$, and the remainder of the binary representation of $1$ modulo that same modulus.
caveat: The snippet does not define the pair encoding, projections, or remainder routine, so the exact state representation is opaque.
